core: Apical epithelial membrane polarity and transport
qualifier: biliary phospholipid and bile acid secretion
name: Apical epithelial transport and biliary lipid secretion
rationale: Members concern apical/raft protein targeting, CFTR, microvilli and epithelial transport; phospholipid flipping and ABCB4/ABCB11 bile secretion distinguish it from the anion-transport and scrambling confusables.

name: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development and innervation
rationale: Members cover sympathetic, DRG, trigeminal, facial and branchiomotor neuron differentiation, migration and axon outgrowth; the peripheral/sympathetic innervation members separate it from hindbrain and cranial ganglion confusables.

name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis subversion of phagosome acidification and maturation
rationale: Members combine phagosome/endosome acidification and phagolysosome fusion with Mtb strategies blocking them and other host defences; the acidification and fusion members distinguish it from toxin, Listeria and Mtb iron-uptake confusables.

core: Filopodium assembly and actin-based cell shape
name: Filopodium assembly and actin-driven cell shape
rationale: Members regulate filopodia, polarity-driven cell shape and postsynaptic actin (via RHOF and EPHB); this protrusion focus separates it from dendrite-branching, actin-severing and ephrin-repulsion confusables.

name: Endocardium, trabeculation and coronary vessel development
rationale: Members cover endocardial differentiation and morphogenesis, trabecula formation and coronary vasculogenesis/smooth muscle; these non-myocardial structures distinguish it from myocardium and septum confusables.

name: Bicarbonate and inorganic anion exchange in acid-base balance
rationale: Members involve SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, sulfate, oxalate and iodide transport plus carbonic anhydrase and proton/pH control; the pH members separate it from the phosphate-mineralisation and organelle-acidification confusables.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment and endocytic entry
rationale: Members describe virion receptor binding, endocytic uptake and promotion of viral entry; the generic receptor-mediated endocytosis members distinguish it from virus-specific Dengue/RSV entry and host suppression confusables.

name: Skeletal myoblast differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell regeneration
rationale: Members regulate myoblast proliferation, differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell activation in skeletal muscle; the regeneration and myoblast control members separate it from atrophy, extraocular muscle and cardiac confusables.

name: Pain, itch and thermosensation via TRP channels and tachykinins
rationale: Members detect painful thermal/mechanical stimuli, itch, acid and fever via TRP channels and tachykinin signalling; these distinguish it from K2P channel and chemosensory confusables.

name: LDL receptor family degradation limiting lipoprotein uptake
rationale: Members concern LDLR/VLDLR particle handling, its LXR-driven restriction and negative regulation of LDL clearance; this uptake-restraint focus separates it from HDL efflux, SREBP and lipoprotein assembly confusables.

qualifier: dietary fat absorption and lipase activation
name: Dietary fat absorption and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein turnover
rationale: Members cover lipid digestion, chylomicron/VLDL assembly, LPL/LIPC lipolysis and clearance; the absorption and assembly members distinguish it from HDL/LDL remodelling and phospholipase confusables.

name: Glutamate, aspartate and GABA reuptake and metabolism
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane EAAT glutamate/aspartate and GABA uptake, their transporter diseases and GABA synthesis; these separate it from vesicular loading, glycinergic and monoamine confusables.

qualifier: ALK, FGFR and PDGFR fusions and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic ALK, FGFR and PDGFR fusions and resistance mutants
rationale: Members are cancer-driving RTK fusions, amplifications and TKI-resistant mutants of ALK, FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and LTK; the ALK/FGFR/PDGFR content distinguishes it from FLT3-, KIT- and EGFR/ERBB2-focused confusables.

core: p53 regulation in DNA damage and cell cycle
qualifier: p14ARF/TP53 loss in cancer and G2/M progression
name: p53 control, ARF loss in cancer and G2/M progression
rationale: Members regulate p53 stability, activity and apoptotic output, its cancer loss via p14ARF/TP53 defects, and G2/M progression; the ARF/TP53 loss members distinguish it from radiation-checkpoint and p21/G1-arrest confusables.

name: CNS myelination, oligodendrocyte development and glial reactivity
rationale: Members cover CNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation, and gliosis; the oligodendrocyte/CNS focus separates it from Schwann cell, node and axon-regeneration confusables.

name: Cyclooxygenase-mediated prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis
rationale: All members describe COX conversion of arachidonate to prostaglandins and thromboxanes, distinguishing it from prostanoid regulation, secretion and receptor confusables.

name: Enteric neural crest development via RET and endothelin signalling
rationale: Members concern neural crest migration into the gut, enteric nervous system and midgut development with GDNF/RET and endothelin receptor signalling; the RET/GDNF members distinguish it from gut motility and sympathoadrenal confusables.

name: Hedgehog N-terminal palmitoylation and ligand release
rationale: Members cover N-terminal protein lipidation, HHAT palmitoylation of Hedgehog and release of lipidated Hh; this distinguishes it from Hh autoprocessing, Wnt acylation, GPI and O-glycosylation confusables.

name: GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis disorders
rationale: Members cover mannose metabolism, GDP-mannose and Dol-P-Man synthesis and the CDGs from PMM2, MPI, PGM1 and DOLK defects; the upstream GDP-mannose steps distinguish it from DPM-complex and later N-glycan CDG confusables.

core: Adenine nucleotide, NAD and phosphocreatine energy metabolism
name: Mitochondrial ATP/ADP, NAD and creatine energetics with viral apoptosis
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial ATP/ADP and NAD transport, NAD salvage, creatine/phosphocreatine and viral MOMP-induced apoptosis; the creatine and viral apoptosis members separate it from nucleotide-interconversion and tryptophan-NAD confusables.

core: Synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine regulation
name: Reelin-regulated synaptic plasticity, dendritic spines and memory
rationale: Members regulate LTP/LTD, spine maintenance, postsynaptic calcium and memory with Reelin signalling and amyloid-beta responses; these distinguish it from neurodegeneration, synaptic translation and spine-cytoskeleton confusables.

name: Colony-stimulating factor signalling in monocyte and macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members cover M-CSF, GM-CSF and G-CSF production and signalling driving monocyte, macrophage and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation; the CSF production and differentiation members distinguish it from SIRP, DAP12 and IL-6 confusables.

qualifier: ESCRT-III abscission and nuclear envelope resealing
name: Cytokinesis, abscission and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope resealing
rationale: Members span spindle midzone, contractile ring and furrow formation, midbody abscission and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing; these late-mitotic events distinguish it from chromosome cohesion, checkpoint and lamina disassembly confusables.

name: Netrin signalling in axon extension and chemorepulsion
rationale: Members describe netrin signalling and positive/negative control of axon extension and chemorepulsion during guidance; the netrin members distinguish it from Sema3A, ephrin and neuron-type-specific guidance confusables.

name: AMPA receptor clustering and trapping in excitatory transmission
rationale: Members regulate AMPA/glutamate receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and activity in excitatory transmission and short-term plasticity; the clustering members distinguish it from presynaptic, kainate and NMDA confusables.
